_about: Hand-checked model -> manual URL. Read by stepspotter.research before any search engine, and shipped inside the container image (COPY data/manuals). Keys are research.slug(guess_product(task)): lowercase brand and model, non-alphanumerics collapsed to one dash.
_how_checked: curl -sSL -A '<desktop UA>' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type} %{size_download}' <url>. Only entries that came back 200 with a PDF content type are listed under "manuals".

westinghouse-epx3030.what: Westinghouse ePX3030 electric pressure washer, owner's manual (assembly on pages 10-14)

ryobi-ry31012.what: Ryobi RY31012 12 in. surface cleaner attachment, operator's sheet (995000011 REV:01, English pages 1-2)
ryobi-ry31012.host: Home Depot's CDN, hosting the Techtronic/Ryobi document itself; ryobitools.com has no direct PDF for this accessory

legrand-en0800.what: Legrand On-Q structured wiring and connectivity guide; names the EN0800 enclosure and the modules that go in it
legrand-en0800.result: 200 application/pdf 4481516 bytes, 28 pages with a text layer
legrand-en0800.caveat: a product and connectivity guide, not a step-by-step install manual; it grounds part names, not an assembly order

apc-bx1350m.why: no URL we could verify. Schneider/APC answer an automated fetch with HTTP 403 on www.se.com and www.apc.com, apcmedia.com 403s, and the 990-5813A file path on download.schneider-electric.com returns 404 (all checked 2026-09-11). The copies a search turns up sit on retailer and marketplace hosts, which is not the maker's document.
apc-bx1350m.effect: an APC BX1350M lookup falls through to the search engines like any unlisted model, and says so in the trace.
